| align="left" colspan="6"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small>
{{refbegin}}
{{note|chief1|<small>1</small>}} <small>A Chief's Immunity Bracelet was used, however, no votes were against its user.</small><br />
{{note|chief2|<small>2</small>}} <small>A Chief's Immunity Bracelet was used, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>3</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, Alexandre, Béatrice, and Maxime agreed to eliminate Frédéric.</small><br />
{{note|immunity|<small>4</small>}} <small>During the Immunity Challenge, the castaways had the opportunity to forfeit the challenge and participate in a mini-<br />challenge to earn a separate Immunity Necklace. Clo, Sophie, Alexandre and Mohamed took the chance and the latter<br />won himself Immunity.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>5</small>}}<small>Sophie was Brice's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when he was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|necklace|<small>6</small>}}<small>An Immunity Necklace was played, therefore all votes against the user were negated.</small><br />
{{note|elim|<small>7</small>}}<small>Nicolas came in last in the special Immunity Challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.</small><br />
{{note|tie|<small>8</small>}} <small>With a deadlocked tie between Clo and Cyril, both of them were forced to draw rocks to determine who would be<br />eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|final5|<small>9</small>}} <small>At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge, where two castaways were<br />eliminated. Clo and Aurélien came in last and were therfore eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
